About

Scholarship and service

Ustadh Abdulrahman G. Caderao is an Islamic scholar and educator in Davao City. His studies in Islamic jurisprudence focused on Fiqh and Usul al-Fiqh, and he trained in Islamic preaching and Ifta in Cairo.

While serving as Executive Program Director of Davao City’s Madrasah Comprehensive Development and Promotion Unit, he spoke about the role of traditional madrasah education in preserving Islamic teachings and supporting Arabic literacy and peaceful coexistence.
